visual_action: A fast-paced montage featuring patriotic and presidential imagery. The video includes shots of an American flag waving over a military cemetery, fighter jets flying in formation and breaking the sound barrier, Donald Trump interacting with factory workers, walking through a crowd, and speaking on stage. It also shows Air Force One flying over a stadium, a presidential motorcade at dusk, and concludes with black-and-white footage of the White House and Marine One, with "THE WHITE HOUSE" displayed as on-screen text.
